meta.name: add-teams
meta.description: Add Microsoft Teams channel integration via Chat SDK.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 集成 Microsoft Teams 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Teams 消息通知功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Microsoft Teams channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Teams messaging to your application

howto.what: 它会从 channels 分支把 Teams 适配器复制进 src/channels/ 并注册、装上 @chat-adapter/teams,再构建并跑注册测试;随后用 Teams CLI 创建机器人、生成凭据写入 .env,并给出安装链接。
howto.when: 当你要给 NanoClaw 接入 Microsoft Teams 通道时触发。它会先查 .env,若已有 Teams 凭据就跳过创建步骤直接进入重启。

say.text: 帮我给 NanoClaw 接入 Microsoft Teams 通道
say.note: 复制并注册 Teams 适配器,再引导创建机器人

say.text: 机器人就叫 NanoClaw,公网地址用我的隧道 URL
say.note: 对应 app_name 和 public_url 两个提示

say.text: 把助手接到登录的这个 Teams 账号上
say.note: 对应 wire_owner 确认,助手会先给对方发消息

howto.what_en: It copies the Teams adapter from the channels branch into src/channels/, registers it, installs @chat-adapter/teams@4.29.0, builds and runs the registration test, then uses the Teams CLI to create a bot and write credentials to .env.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a Microsoft Teams channel to NanoClaw. It first checks .env and, if Teams credentials already exist, skips the create prompts straight to Restart.

say_en.text: Add a Microsoft Teams channel to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Copies and registers the adapter, then guides bot creation

say_en.text: Call the bot NanoClaw and use my tunnel URL
say_en.note: Fills the app_name and public_url prompts

say_en.text: Wire the assistant to this signed-in Teams account
say_en.note: Confirms wire_owner; the assistant messages it first
